issues.claim: His field work includes a dense multi-level piezometer network and particle-tracking transport simulation at a production well field.

sources.quote: A steady-state and transient groundwater flow model was constructed for a 3.2 km reach of the Tisa River near Titel, Vojvodina, to simulate bank filtrate travel times under varying pumping and river-stage conditions.

issues.explanation: The particle-tracking work in SYN-PUB-03045 is a numerical modelling study (MODFLOW-2005 with MT3DMS), not field work; rephrase to separate field instrumentation experience from modelling experience so the researcher's skills are not overstated.
